acks.note: Every video page now has a 'Why this video' card (research's reason, the angle, the video that inspired it with its YouTube views, and the pages research read), and the Videos list shows 'Inspired by … · N views' under each title.

Where demand is measured from (channels with many views but few subscribers, not big channels) is how research picks topics, so it's research's to change; the dashboard now shows each video's reference video and its views so you can check the picks.

Every video shows why it was made, the proven video that inspired it with its YouTube views, and the pages research read: a line under each title in the Videos list and a 'Why this video' card on its page. The reason is now saved with the video at ingest, so it stays after the topic leaves the research feed.
